name: openrouter-vscode
description: Toggle the free-claude-code Anthropic proxy server and inject terminal environment variables

openrouter.apiKey.markdownDescription: OpenRouter API key injected as `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` into terminals

openrouter.modelOpus.markdownDescription: Model used for Claude Opus requests. Format: `provider/model-name` — e.g. `open_router/anthropic/claude-opus-4`. Falls back to `#openrouter.model#` if empty.

openrouter.modelSonnet.markdownDescription: Model used for Claude Sonnet requests. Format: `provider/model-name` — e.g. `open_router/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. Falls back to `#openrouter.model#` if empty.

openrouter.modelHaiku.markdownDescription: Model used for Claude Haiku requests. Format: `provider/model-name` — e.g. `open_router/anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`. Falls back to `#openrouter.model#` if empty.

openrouter.model.markdownDescription: Fallback model used for all Claude requests that don't match a specific tier override. Format: `provider/model-name` — e.g. `open_router/meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct:free`. Valid providers: `nvidia_nim`, `open_router`, `lmstudio`. Leave empty to use the server's built-in default (`nvidia_nim/meta/llama3-70b-instruct`).

openrouter.port.markdownDescription: Port on which uvicorn will listen

openrouter.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the proxy server directory. Leave empty to use the bundled `server/` folder included with this extension.

openrouter.autoStartServer.markdownDescription: Automatically start the uvicorn server when the toggle is enabled
